export const T = {
  bg: 'linear-gradient(180deg,#7EB6E3 0%,#BFDCEC 45%,#F3E9DC 100%)',
  bgSolid: '#F3E9DC',
  bgCard: '#FFFFFF',
  bgCardHover: '#FBF7F0',
  bgCardSolid: '#FFFFFF',
  border: '#E4DCC8',
  borderStrong: '#D3C7A8',
  primary: '#16233F',
  text: '#16233F',
  textSub: '#3D4E6B',
  textMuted: '#7A8699',
  accent: '#E8834D',
  accentHover: '#D9723B',
  accentGlow: 'rgba(232,131,77,0.25)',

  gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #16233F 0%, #2A3B5C 100%)',
  gradientOrange: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #E8834D 0%, #D9723B 100%)',
  gradientBlue: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2E5C8A 0%, #1E4569 100%)',
  gradientGreen: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #3B7A57 0%, #2C5D42 100%)',
  gradientGold: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #E8834D 0%, #B8862E 100%)',
  primaryGlow: 'rgba(22,35,63,0.08)',

  red: '#C4453A', redBg: '#FDF0EE',
  green: '#3B7A57', greenBg: '#EEF6F1',
  blue: '#2E5C8A', blueBg: '#EBF2F8',
  orange: '#E8834D', orangeBg: 'rgba(232,131,77,0.12)',
  yellow: '#B8862E', yellowBg: 'rgba(184,134,46,0.12)',
  pink: '#C46B84', pinkBg: 'rgba(196,107,132,0.12)',
}

export const FREE_STORAGE  = 1  * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
export const PRO_STORAGE   = 10 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
export const FREE_MAX_FILE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
export const PRO_MAX_FILE  = 500 * 1024 * 1024
